log.query: Emergent founders Mukund Jha Madhav Jha status 2025 2026
log.found: Both twin brothers remain active. Mukund Jha is CEO, Madhav Jha is CTO. Emergent became unicorn at $1.5B valuation in Series C (July 2026). Previously co-founded Dunzo.
No departures. Both founders still leading the company.
